This '''battle''' was fought in the [[Tionese War]] between the young [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]], over control of [[Roche asteroid field|Roche]]. Coming off of their [[Battle of Abhean|victory]] at [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]], the Tionese were successful in conquering Roche as well.
